two_stage_protocol: First calibrate convergence on official TRAIN/VAL, using TRAIN-only preprocessing. Freeze per-fold/seed LR schedule and optional recovery anchor. Then initialize a new model on the original official TRAIN+VAL fit pool with fit-pool-only preprocessing, replay the locked schedule and any preselected recovery epoch, and require final FIT stationarity. No held-out validation claim is made for final TRAIN+VAL refits.
evaluation: Independent causal3EMA parameter and floating-buffer average after10 local epochs; terminal converged state only
recovery: Calibration failures at120: copy own minimumDEVCE EMA state into fresh learner/EMA and freshAdamW for40 epochs at3e-6; preserve full history. Final refit replays the calibration-selected anchor epoch using its own TRAIN+VAL checkpoint, never chooses an anchor from Test.
final_refit_extra_epochs: Without recovery, at least calibration base length and at most120 epochs; after locked schedule ends, continue at3e-6 only if FIT losses/parameters are not stationary. With recovery, replay120 base plus40 recovery epochs.
aggregation: Mean3neural-seeds within each outer fold, then equal mean5folds; fixed tree reused across3 seeds, never counted as3 independent tree fits
test_policy: Do not open Test targets during preparation/calibration/refit. Only after all40 final models pass and a training lock is written generate all Test predictions, freeze their SHA256 manifest, then score once. No Test-based selection, fallback, retry or hyperparameter changes.
